title: Three false signals: free memory, the zsh loop, the silent rsync
description: Three diagnosis traps from one operator session and the rule for each: memory_pressure's free percentage read 84% while 59 of 64 GB was in use and swap 6.9 of 8 GB, so diagnose with sysctl vm.swapusage, vm_stat and a process tree before naming a culprit; the Bash tool shell is zsh on macOS and never word-splits $var, so a one-liner loop sent one malformed URL and five minutes of 404s, which loops-in-script-files and the display-lint advisory now say; and macOS openrsync dry-run output is silent without -v and formatted differently from CI GNU rsync, which #4079 proved, so rsync-parsing tests must work on both dialects.
